detail: Full summary: this failure mode is silent and structural, not a one-off. Because the global twining-mcp bin is npm-linked to this repo's dist/, every rebuild makes already-running servers stale, and nothing surfaces which build a server is actually running. Any behaviour observed through a long-lived session may reflect code from an arbitrary earlier point. Diagnose with `ps` + readlink + dist mtimes before concluding a code defect — I spent a full investigation cycle concluding a bug that did not exist.
